correctness.rationale: The proof reduces the definition to domination of the positive support after a one-unit transfer. With center label two, every zero peripheral vertex is defended by the center and the center remains positive. With center label one, an empty blade can only be defended through the center and is therefore permitted exactly when every other blade is nonempty; zeros in nonempty blades can be defended internally. With center label zero, domination and transfer feasibility are both equivalent to every blade being nonempty. These disjoint cases give the generating function exactly. The standalone exhaustive checker independently verifies the structural criterion, every coefficient, and the minimum layer on six parameter tuples; the unbounded theorem rests on the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The result gives the complete weight distribution, not merely the minimum parameter, for a natural block-graph family that contains friendship graphs and unequal clique windmills. The factorization isolates a sharp local-to-global rule at the universal cut vertex: the allowed number of empty blades is exactly two-state dependent on the center label. This structural classification yields total counts and an abrupt minimum-layer transition between two blades and at least three blades, providing reusable exact information rather than a routine scalar recomputation.
